key_idea: Count path endpoints per vertex: at a vertex with incident demands summing to S and maximum M, paths through it can be paired up locally leaving max(2M-S, S mod 2) forced endpoints, and these local optima are simultaneously achievable.
sketch: For each vertex accumulate S and M over incident edges, sum max(2M-S, S mod 2) over all vertices and divide by 2 (each path has two endpoints). O(N). Use 64-bit integers since sums reach about 5e14. Both samples verified; the formula is the standard pairing argument (pair path stubs from different edges at each vertex).
